item.title: Refactor orders status String into OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
The `orders` crate stores an order's status as a `String` and compares string literals all over the code. Refactor it to a proper type.

Requirements:
- Add `src/status.rs` with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least `Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash`.
- `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` returns the lowercase names ("pending", "paid", "shipped", "cancelled"); `Display` prints the same.
- `FromStr` for `OrderStatus` with `type Err = ParseStatusError`, a public error type that implements `std::error::Error` and whose message names the rejected input.
- `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` encodes the lifecycle: pending -> paid, pending -> cancelled, paid -> shipped, paid -> cancelled; nothing else.
- `Order::status` becomes an `OrderStatus`; re-export `OrderStatus` and `ParseStatusError` from the crate root; use the enum everywhere, so the status string literals appear only in `src/status.rs`.

Observable behaviour (errors, report output and ordering, parsing) must stay exactly the same, and `cargo test` must pass. Commit the work on the local branch (ship mode is local). Use the Git identity already configured for the repository; add no attribution lines beyond the Co-Authored-By trailer from the environment. Keep functions under 60 lines and add meaningful assertions at parsing and transition boundaries.

state.summary:
Refactored the orders crate's status String into an OrderStatus enum on archon/2fz8zka5-refactor-orders-status-string-into-order, committed as c94e653 (not pushed). Added src/status.rs with OrderStatus (as_str, Display, FromStr, can_transition_to) and ParseStatusError, re-exported from the crate root. Order::status is now OrderStatus, and pay/ship/cancel share one Order::transition path. Error messages, from_line parse errors, report ordering and the other functions behave as before. status_counts now returns Vec<(OrderStatus, usize)> instead of String, a public API change. Checks on the final head: cargo test passes (3 original plus 2 new tests, 5 total), cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings is clean, cargo fmt --check is clean (the base was not rustfmt-clean; cargo fmt was run). Status literals appear only in src/status.rs. Nothing is left running. Open follow-up (non-blocking): OrderStatus derives Ord by declaration order, not name order, so a future sort on OrderStatus would differ from report ordering. evidence.none: Pure refactor with no visible or measurable change; behaviour is covered by the test assertions on error messages and report output.

pr.body: Approach: add src/status.rs (OrderStatus, ParseStatusError). Order::status becomes OrderStatus. pay, ship and cancel call Order::transition, which checks can_transition_to and keeps the existing error text ("order N cannot be <status>: it is <status>"). from_line parses via FromStr; its error text is unchanged ("unknown status \"x\""). status_counts keeps status-name ordering and now returns OrderStatus. Public API changes: Order.status type, status_counts return type. Checks: cargo test (5 passed), clippy -D warnings clean, fmt clean. Tests added: transition table over all 16 pairs, parse round trip and error text. Follow-up (non-blocking): OrderStatus derives Ord in declaration order, which differs from name order.
pr.summary: Order status is now a typed enum with validated parsing and an explicit lifecycle. Before: status was a String compared against literals in several files. Now: OrderStatus encodes the lifecycle in can_transition_to, parsing rejects unknown names with ParseStatusError, and status literals live only in src/status.rs. Behaviour is unchanged.
pr.title: Refactor order status from String into OrderStatus enum

risk.why: Small crate, behaviour preserved and covered by tests. Public type change of Order.status and status_counts return type. Reviewer confirmed medium.
